key.name: window-mode
key.description: Fullscreen mode maximizes apps on taskbar activation (taskbar stays visible via its strut); windowed mode activates without maximizing.

key.name: taskbar-autohide
key.description: Reserved for a future taskbar autohide behavior; the taskbar does not read this key yet.

key.name: ai-provider
key.description: Selected AI provider for the agent service; the routing engine (module 4) resolves the provider catalog.

key.name: ai-model
key.description: Selected AI model within ai-provider; empty means the routing engine picks (module 4).

key.name: routing-mode
key.description: Auto lets the routing engine choose provider/model; manual pins ai-provider/ai-model.

key.name: agent-full-access
key.description: Phase 3 module 4: when true, the agent service auto-approves every approval ticket (including destructive and out-of-workspace operations) instead of waiting for the human approval popup. Tickets are still created and logged, so the audit trail stays complete. Default false: every tier 1/2 tool call waits for human approval.
